titleZh: AI 之後：未來 50 年，哪些技術值得持續關注？
titleEn: After AI: Which technologies deserve attention over the next 50 years?
questionZh: 未來 10、20、30、40、50 年，哪些技術可能最具跨產業影響力？從電氣化、微軟與個人電腦、智慧型手機的歷史，可以學到什麼，以及今天應如何選擇研究與學習方向？
questionEn: Which technologies could have the greatest cross-industry influence in 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 years? What can electrification, Microsoft and personal computers, and smartphones teach us about research and learning decisions today?
provenanceZh: 由助理在模型討論前整理並開啟來源查核的研究簡報，與實際討論紀錄分開保存。這是有界資料蒐集，不是系統性文獻回顧。
provenanceEn: An assistant-prepared brief with opened and checked sources, prepared before model discussion and stored separately. This is a bounded evidence scan, not a systematic review.
scopeZh: 以 2026 年為起點；引領潮流定義為跨產業用途、持續改善、實際採用與可持續的成本效益，不以新聞熱度、單一公司股價或單次實驗紀錄排序。
scopeEn: Horizons start in 2026. Leadership means cross-industry usefulness, sustained improvement, real adoption and viable economics, rather than media attention, a company's share price or a one-off laboratory record.
summaryZh: 目前較合理的工作假說是：下一波可能是 AI 成為基礎層，再與機器人、能源系統及生物工程結合。2036 年仍可根據採用與瓶頸做有條件判斷；2046 年後分支增多；2056–2076 年應用情境與里程碑管理，而不是指定某項技術必然接棒。
summaryEn: A useful working hypothesis is that AI becomes an infrastructure layer and combines with robotics, energy systems and biological engineering. Adoption and bottlenecks can inform conditional judgments about 2036; branches multiply after 2046. For 2056–2076, use scenarios and milestones instead of declaring a certain successor.

evidenceLegend.descriptionZh: 來源直接報告的歷史、統計或實驗結果。
evidenceLegend.descriptionEn: Historical, statistical or experimental findings reported directly by a source.

evidenceLegend.descriptionZh: 本簡報對現有證據的解讀；不是來源作者對指定年份的預言。
evidenceLegend.descriptionEn: Interpretation by this brief, not a source author's prediction for the stated year.

evidenceLegend.descriptionZh: 用來比較可能路徑；沒有經驗證的機率或確定時間表。
evidenceLegend.descriptionEn: Possible paths for comparison, without validated probabilities or a certain timetable.

sources.title: General Purpose Technologies and Surges in Productivity: Historical Reflections on the Future of the ICT Revolution
sources.publisher: University of Oxford / David and Wright
sources.summaryZh: 電氣化的效益伴隨工廠配置、組織與勞動市場變化；技術擴散並非自動或各國一致。
sources.summaryEn: Electrification's gains accompanied changes in factory layouts, organizations and labour markets; diffusion was neither automatic nor identical across countries.
sources.limitationZh: 歷史研究提供機制類比，不能把當時的等待年數套成 AI 的倒數計時。
sources.limitationEn: Historical mechanisms offer analogies, not a countdown that fixes the timing of AI's benefits.

sources.title: The Productivity J-Curve: How Intangibles Complement General Purpose Technologies
sources.summaryZh: 通用技術需要互補的無形投資；組織與軟體投入可使生產力效益延遲呈現，也影響統計衡量。
sources.summaryEn: General-purpose technologies require complementary intangible investment. Organizational and software investment can delay measured gains and affect productivity accounting.
sources.limitationZh: 模型及美國資料分析不保證任何新技術都會成功，也不是 50 年技術排名。
sources.limitationEn: The model and US evidence do not guarantee success for every new technology or rank technologies 50 years ahead.

sources.title: U.S. v. Microsoft: Court's Findings of Fact
sources.publisher: U.S. District Court / U.S. Department of Justice
sources.summaryZh: 法院記錄描述 Windows 使用者與相容應用程式之間的正回饋，以及應用程式進入障礙。
sources.summaryEn: The findings describe feedback between Windows users and compatible applications, including the applications barrier to entry.
sources.limitationZh: 這是 1990 年代特定市場的法院事實認定，不是今天的市場描述，也不能單獨解釋微軟全部歷史。
sources.limitationEn: These are findings about a specific 1990s market, not today's market or a complete explanation of Microsoft's history.

sources.title: Apple Reinvents the Phone with iPhone
sources.summaryZh: 首代 iPhone 公告記錄電話、音樂、網路與多點觸控介面的整合，是產品組合創新的歷史例子。
sources.summaryEn: The original iPhone announcement documents the integration of telephony, music, internet access and multi-touch interaction.
sources.limitationZh: 公司當時的產品公告可證明公布內容；不能單靠它證明市場成功、因果關係或整個智慧型手機產業的起源。
sources.limitationEn: A company announcement establishes what was announced; it does not establish market success, causal impact or the origin of the whole smartphone industry.

sources.title: Inside the AI Index: 12 Takeaways from the 2026 Report
sources.summaryZh: 報告記錄 AI 能力與科學應用進展，同時呈現多步規劃、實體任務、透明度與環境成本的限制。
sources.summaryEn: The report records progress in AI capabilities and scientific applications alongside limitations in multistep planning, physical tasks, transparency and environmental costs.
sources.limitationZh: 不同評測衡量不同能力；不能把基準分數直接當成實際工作可靠性、整體生產力或 AGI 的證明。
sources.limitationEn: Benchmarks measure different capabilities; scores do not directly establish workplace reliability, economy-wide productivity or AGI.

sources.title: Key Questions on Energy and AI — Executive summary
sources.summaryZh: IEA 中央預測資料中心用電由 2025 年 485 TWh 增至 2030 年約 950 TWh；電網、供應鏈與資金形成瓶頸。
sources.summaryEn: The IEA's central projection increases data-centre electricity use from 485 TWh in 2025 to about 950 TWh in 2030, with grid, supply-chain and financing constraints.
sources.limitationZh: 2030 數字是預測，資料中心也不等於全是 AI；成長取決於效率、需求及建設，不能外推至 2076。
sources.limitationEn: The 2030 figure is a projection, and data centres are not all AI. Demand, efficiency and construction matter; it cannot be extrapolated to 2076.

sources.title: World Robotics 2025 — Global Robot Demand in Factories Doubles Over 10 Years
sources.summaryZh: IFR 統計 2024 年新增 542,000 台工業機器人，超過十年前兩倍，顯示工廠自動化已有規模。
sources.summaryEn: IFR records 542,000 industrial robot installations in 2024, more than twice the level ten years earlier, showing established industrial deployment.
sources.limitationZh: 工業機器人的安裝數不能證明通用人形或家庭機器人已成熟；產業協會統計也不是隨機試驗。
sources.limitationEn: Industrial installations do not establish the readiness of general-purpose humanoid or household robots; federation statistics are not randomized evidence.

sources.title: Infant with rare, incurable disease is first to successfully receive personalized gene therapy treatment
sources.summaryZh: NIH 報告一名 CPS1 缺乏症嬰兒接受客製化體細胞基因編輯，並出現初步臨床改善。
sources.summaryEn: NIH reports personalized somatic gene editing in one infant with CPS1 deficiency and early clinical improvement.
sources.limitationZh: 單一病人與短期結果不能證明長期安全、普遍療效、可負擔性，或延緩一般人的老化。
sources.limitationEn: One patient and early outcomes do not establish long-term safety, general efficacy, affordability or slower aging in the wider population.

sources.title: Reinforcement learning control of quantum error correction
sources.summaryZh: Willow 處理器實驗以強化學習調整控制參數、改善量子記憶糾錯穩定性，是 AI 與量子硬體互補的實例。
sources.summaryEn: Experiments on Willow use reinforcement learning to tune control parameters and improve quantum-memory error-correction stability, illustrating AI and quantum-hardware complementarity.
sources.limitationZh: 實驗聚焦量子記憶；大規模延伸部分使用模擬，不能據此宣稱通用商業量子優勢已實現。
sources.limitationEn: The experiment focuses on quantum memory; larger-scale extensions include simulation, not proof of general commercial quantum advantage.

sources.title: Fusion Science and Technology Roadmap
sources.summaryZh: 路線圖列出材料、燃料循環、氚自給與整合運轉等缺口，規劃支持商業化的研究和測試。
sources.summaryEn: The roadmap identifies gaps in materials, fuel cycles, tritium self-sufficiency and integrated operation, and plans research and testing toward commercialization.
sources.limitationZh: 路線圖的時程是目標，不是已完成的商業發電成果；文件也不承諾特定經費。
sources.limitationEn: Roadmap dates are targets, not achieved commercial generation; the document also does not commit specific funding.

horizons.themeZh: AI 深入工作流程；機器人與電力基礎設施同步擴張
horizons.themeEn: AI embedded in workflows, with robotics and power infrastructure expanding
horizons.rationaleZh: 目前的能力與採用趨勢支持優先追蹤 AI 軟體、自動化和支撐它們的電網／算力；工業機器人已有部署基礎。這是本簡報的條件式判斷。
horizons.rationaleEn: Current capability and adoption evidence supports prioritizing AI software, automation and the grids and compute that support them; industrial robotics already has a deployment base. This is the brief's conditional judgment.
horizons.uncertaintyZh: 可靠性、整合成本、能源與組織變革可能限制擴張；AI 基準進步不等於每一份工作都能自動化。
horizons.uncertaintyEn: Reliability, integration costs, energy and organizational change may constrain expansion; stronger AI benchmarks do not mean every job can be automated.
horizons.watchZh: 跨公司實測的任務完成率、總使用成本、持續採用率，以及電網接入時間。
horizons.watchEn: Cross-company task success, total operating cost, sustained adoption and grid-connection times.

horizons.themeZh: 實體 AI 與可程式化生物工程成為重要候選
horizons.themeEn: Physical AI and programmable biology become major candidates
horizons.rationaleZh: 如果通用操作與基因編輯的成本、可靠性和驗證取得進展，AI 可能從數位工作擴展到製造、照護與生物研發；兩条路線可以互補。
horizons.rationaleEn: If general manipulation and gene editing improve in cost, reliability and validation, AI could extend from digital work into manufacturing, care and biological R&D; the two paths can complement each other.
horizons.uncertaintyZh: 沒有資料足以保證 2046 年普及；工廠機器人不能代表家庭能力，單一病人的治療也不能代表普遍醫療。
horizons.uncertaintyEn: No evidence guarantees broad deployment by 2046; factory robots do not represent household capability, and one patient's treatment does not represent general medicine.
horizons.watchZh: 陌生環境中的長時間可靠操作，以及多中心臨床結果、長期安全與製造成本。
horizons.watchEn: Reliable long-duration operation in unfamiliar environments, plus multicentre clinical results, long-term safety and manufacturing costs.

horizons.themeZh: 能源、計算與生物技術可能共同推動新一波產業變化
horizons.themeEn: Energy, computing and biology could jointly drive another industrial shift
horizons.rationaleZh: 若低成本可靠能源和自動化研發成熟，可能加速新材料、生物製造及工業系統；量子計算與融合能源是需持續驗證的候選。
horizons.rationaleEn: If reliable low-cost energy and automated R&D mature, they could accelerate materials, biomanufacturing and industrial systems; quantum computing and fusion remain candidates requiring continued validation.
horizons.uncertaintyZh: 這是情境，不是技術成熟年表。量子糾錯與融合研究里程碑都不等於有競爭力的完整商業系統。
horizons.uncertaintyEn: This is a scenario, not a maturity timetable. Quantum error correction and fusion milestones do not equal competitive complete commercial systems.
horizons.watchZh: 可重現的有用量子優勢；融合電廠的淨售電、運轉率、燃料供應與完整成本。
horizons.watchEn: Reproducible useful quantum advantage; net electricity sold, availability, fuel supply and full costs for fusion plants.

horizons.themeZh: 智慧、能源與生物工程的整合，或受瓶頸限制的緩慢擴散
horizons.themeEn: Convergence of intelligence, energy and biology—or slow diffusion under constraints
horizons.rationaleZh: 可比較兩條路：多種技術互相加速，或資源、制度和安全要求使採用緩慢。歷史顯示發明、商業化和社會普及是不同階段。
horizons.rationaleEn: Compare two paths: technologies accelerate one another, or resources, institutions and safety requirements slow adoption. History distinguishes invention, commercialization and broad diffusion.
horizons.uncertaintyZh: 40 年外無法可靠排出冠軍；這些來源只支撐今天的起點與機制，不直接預測 2066 年。
horizons.uncertaintyEn: A winner cannot be ranked reliably 40 years ahead; these sources support present conditions and mechanisms, not a direct forecast for 2066.
horizons.watchZh: 成果是否跨產業、跨國普及，以及成本下降是否轉化為可觀察的生活與生產改善。
horizons.watchEn: Whether gains diffuse across industries and countries, and whether falling costs translate into observable improvements in lives and production.

horizons.themeZh: 保留未知突破；關注技術組合而非唯一接班者
horizons.themeEn: Keep room for unknown breakthroughs; track combinations rather than one successor
horizons.rationaleZh: 可保留三種情境：AI 持續作為基礎設施；AI 與能源／生物技術融合；出現今天尚難辨識的新平台。這些情境用來檢查決策韌性。
horizons.rationaleEn: Keep three scenarios: AI persists as infrastructure; AI converges with energy and biology; or a platform emerges that is hard to identify today. Use them to test the resilience of decisions.
horizons.uncertaintyZh: 現有學術證據無法支持指定 2076 年單一主導技術或精準機率；不把腦機介面、長生或太空產業直接列成必然結果。
horizons.uncertaintyEn: Current scholarship cannot support a single dominant technology or precise probabilities for 2076; brain interfaces, radical longevity and space industries are not inevitable outcomes.
horizons.watchZh: 定期以新證據重建候選清單，保留改變研究方向的能力。
horizons.watchEn: Rebuild the candidate set as evidence changes and preserve the ability to change research direction.

historicalLessons.titleZh: 電氣化：配套變革讓發明成為效益
historicalLessons.titleEn: Electrification: complementary changes turn invention into gains
historicalLessons.bodyZh: 工廠重設、組織與基礎建設共同影響擴散。類比到今天，AI 的價值也應檢查流程、資料與制度是否配合，而不只看模型分數。
historicalLessons.bodyEn: Factory redesign, organization and infrastructure jointly shaped diffusion. Applied as an analogy today, AI value should be assessed alongside workflows, data and institutions, not just model scores.

historicalLessons.titleZh: 微軟與 PC：相容性和生態系可能比單點技術更關鍵
historicalLessons.titleEn: Microsoft and PCs: compatibility and ecosystems can matter more than isolated features
historicalLessons.bodyZh: Windows 的歷史提醒我們觀察開發者、相容性與使用者之間的回饋。但技術方向的重要性，與哪家公司最終獲益，是不同問題。
historicalLessons.bodyEn: Windows' history suggests watching feedback between developers, compatibility and users. A technology's importance and which company benefits are different questions.

historicalLessons.titleZh: 智慧型手機：成熟元件的整合也能創造新入口
historicalLessons.titleEn: Smartphones: integrating components can create a new access point
historicalLessons.bodyZh: iPhone 公告展示多種功能與新互動介面的組合。對未來的啟發是關注技術如何成為容易採用的產品；這份公告本身不證明成功原因。
historicalLessons.bodyEn: The iPhone announcement illustrates a combination of functions and a new interaction interface. A forward-looking lesson is to watch how technology becomes usable products; the announcement itself does not establish why it succeeded.

decisionTakeaways.titleZh: 把學習主軸放在可轉移能力
decisionTakeaways.bodyZh: 對研究與職涯規劃，先培養統計、實驗設計、程式與 AI 工具能力，再深入一個真實領域；這比預先押定 2076 年的冠軍更容易隨證據調整。
decisionTakeaways.bodyEn: For research and career planning, build statistics, experimental design, programming and AI-tool skills, then depth in a real domain. This is easier to update than committing to a predicted winner in 2076.

decisionTakeaways.titleZh: 把研究題目對準尚未解決的瓶頸
decisionTakeaways.titleEn: Choose research problems around unresolved bottlenecks
decisionTakeaways.bodyZh: 可比較 AI 的可靠性與評估、機器人的環境轉移、能源系統整合，或生物技術的驗證與製造；以自己的能力、資源及興趣篩選。
decisionTakeaways.bodyEn: Compare problems in AI reliability and evaluation, robot transfer across environments, energy-system integration, or biological validation and manufacturing; filter by your abilities, resources and interests.

decisionTakeaways.bodyZh: 記下什麼結果會讓你改變看法，例如可重現的外部測試、實際採用、成本與長期安全。把新聞、示範、商業訂單與驗證完成分開。
decisionTakeaways.bodyEn: Write down results that would change your view: reproducible external tests, actual adoption, costs and long-term safety. Distinguish announcements, demonstrations, commercial orders and completed validation.

decisionTakeaways.titleZh: 先用小型研究探索，再決定長期投入
decisionTakeaways.titleEn: Explore with small studies before long commitments
decisionTakeaways.bodyZh: 挑一個候選領域，做短期文獻整理或可驗證小專題，記錄收穫與障礙，再比較下一步。這是決策建議，不是論文已驗證的最優配置。
decisionTakeaways.bodyEn: Choose a candidate field, complete a short literature scan or verifiable project, record gains and obstacles, then compare next steps. This is decision guidance, not an allocation proven optimal by the cited papers.

debateQuestions.zh: AI 是下一輪技術的競爭者，還是它們共同使用的基礎層？哪些觀察可以區分這兩種說法？
debateQuestions.en: Is AI a competitor to the next wave or an infrastructure layer shared by it? Which observations distinguish those views?

debateQuestions.zh: 什麼證據能把機器人、生物工程、量子計算或融合能源，從實驗進展提升為可規模化產業？
debateQuestions.en: What evidence would move robotics, biological engineering, quantum computing or fusion from experimental progress to scalable industry?

debateQuestions.zh: 如果技術進展比預期快或慢十年，今天的研究與學習選擇是否仍然合理？
debateQuestions.en: If progress is ten years faster or slower than expected, do today's research and learning choices still make sense?
